={

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO audio_transcriptions (
  request_id,
  file_name,
  audio_format,
  audio_duration,
  transcription_text,
  language_detected,
  confidence_score,
  primary_provider,
  providers_used,
  speakers_detected,
  word_count,
  srt_subtitles,
  vtt_subtitles,
  processing_time_ms
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.request_id }}',
  '{{ $json.audio_info.file_name }}',
  '{{ $json.audio_info.format }}',
  {{ $json.audio_info.duration || 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.transcription.text }}',
  '{{ $json.transcription.language }}',
  {{ $json.transcription.confidence || 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.transcription.provider }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.providers_comparison.providers_used) }}',
  {{ $json.speaker_diarization.speakers_detected || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.word_timestamps.total_words }},
  '{{ $json.subtitles.srt }}',
  '{{ $json.subtitles.vtt }}',
  {{ $json.metadata.processing_time_ms }}
) RETURNING *;
